issues: The narration combines wording from Alma 63:5 but changes source punctuation and joins excerpts; use separate verbatim excerpts to preserve the source text exactly.
The established label “Lamanite warriors (Enos to Alma era)” is not supported as a warrior designation in this verse, which identifies only Lamanites; use a neutral Lamanite group label.

The scene assigns the battle to “Nephite armies of Moroni,” but Alma 63:15 identifies Moronihah's people or army, not Moroni's army. The summary avoids this, but the character list mislabels the opposing force.
